content.short: Gimbalabs provides cardano educational resources through Project Based Learning (PBL) and open source cardano.
content.description: The mission of Gimbalabs is to provide educational resources to both newcomers and existing developers in the cardano ecosystem and to build open source infrastructures and dApps for cardano. Currently Gimbalabs provides courses in PBL or project based learning format, with 'Plutus PBL' available now and 'Tokenomics PBL', 'Dandelion PBL' in development. 'Dandelion' is open source infrastructure build by Gimbalabs and current running in beta-production stage. 'Gimbals Bounty Treasury Escrow' or 'GBTE' is another project that is in development in Gimbalabs.
content.meta: Find out about Gimbalabs (Gimbal) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
